stem_book: In the figure shown, find out shift in centre of mass of a system of a uniform circular plate of radius 3R from O in which a hole of radius R is cut whose centre is at 2R distance from the centre of large circular plate (a) R/2 (b) R/5 (c) R/4 (d) none of these
work: shift = R²·2R/(9R² − R²) = R/4 (away from hole)
